description: Begin an undo group. While active, each subsequent script runs as a single undo step, so one Undo reverts a whole tool call (e.g. a multi-step recipe). It cannot merge separate calls into one step — each call is still its own undo entry. Call undo_endGroup() to restore the default.

document_id.description: Which open document to act on: a name (see document_listOpen) or a 0-based index. Defaults to the front document.

name: undo_beginGroup
